## `lr-sankey`

Show how quantities move across stages. The SVG lays out nodes in columns and connects them
with ribbons whose thickness is proportional to the flow. Each node represents the greater of
its incoming and outgoing totals. The legend identifies nodes with outgoing flows and uses the
same colors as their ribbons. Where space permits, a ribbon displays its supplied label or
its formatted value.

| Property | Attribute | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `nodes` | — | Readonly array of `LyraSankeyNode` values. Assign a new array when nodes change. |
| `links` | — | Readonly array of `LyraSankeyLink` values. Assign a new array when links change. |
| `label` | `label` | Accessible chart name. A host `aria-label` takes precedence. |
| `description` | `description` | Optional accessible chart description. |
| `loading` | `loading` | Shows the loading state. Defaults to `false`. |
| `withDataTable` | `with-data-table` | Shows the data table visually. Defaults to `false`. |
| `dataTableToggle` | `data-table-toggle` | Adds a button to show or hide the table. Defaults to `false`. |
| `valueFormatter` | — | Optional `(value: number) => string` for displayed and accessible values. Formatting follows the effective locale by default. |

Give each node a unique string ID and each link a positive, finite value. Parallel links are
supported. Supply unique link IDs when you need stable link identity across updates. Links
without IDs receive generated IDs. The chart skips dangling links and links with invalid values.
Isolated nodes have a value of zero. Circular flows, including self-links, show an error that
names up to five nodes of one cycle as a locale-formatted list. The chart reads the first 1,000
node entries and 4,000 link entries and shows a notice if input exceeds a limit, repeats a node or
link ID (the later entry is skipped), or a ribbon is too small to represent.
Node order within each stage is a heuristic: relaxation passes pull nodes toward their weighted
neighbors, and the chart keeps whichever ordering, starting from the input order, crosses the
fewest flows. It is not guaranteed to be the minimum possible.
Node totals that exceed the numeric range are reported as `Number.MAX_VALUE`. A later change
into the cycle error is announced assertively. If `valueFormatter` throws, the value uses the
default formatting.

The plot fills the host's inline size and its coordinates follow the rendered size, so node and
link labels keep their token font size at any width. Set `--lr-sankey-height` to change the
plot's block size; it defaults to `clamp(var(--lr-size-12rem), 62.5cqi, var(--lr-size-30rem))`.

Tab enters the plot at its first node. The arrow keys move through nodes and then links.
Left and Right follow the reading direction. Home and End move to the first and last mark.
Hover or keyboard focus reveals the tooltip. Escape dismisses it. The data table lists plotted
flows (Source, Target, Name, Value), and a second table lists every node's total, including
isolated nodes. Both remain available to assistive technology while visually collapsed.

**Events:** `lr-datum-activate` fires on click, Enter, or Space. It bubbles, is composed, and
carries `LyraSankeyDatum` detail. Node detail is `{ kind: 'node', id, label, value }`. Link detail is
`{ kind: 'link', id, label, value, source, target }`.
An unlabelled link uses a localized description of its endpoints for the event label.

Nodes and ribbons use the shared `--lr-color-chart-1` through `--lr-color-chart-8` palette.
**CSS custom properties:** `--lr-sankey-height`.
**CSS parts:** `base`, `plot`, `description`, `node`, `node-label`, `link`, `link-label`,
`tooltip`, `legend`, `legend-item`, `legend-swatch`, `legend-label`, `data-table`,
`data-table-toggle`, `empty`, `loading`, `error`, and `limit`.

```html
<lr-sankey id="energy" label="Energy distribution" data-table-toggle></lr-sankey>
<script type="module">
  import '@aceshooting/lyra-ui/components/lr-sankey.js';

  const chart = document.querySelector('#energy');
  chart.nodes = [
    { id: 'solar', label: 'Solar generation' },
    { id: 'grid', label: 'Grid' },
    { id: 'homes', label: 'Homes' },
    { id: 'businesses', label: 'Businesses' },
  ];
  chart.links = [
    { source: 'solar', target: 'grid', value: 90 },
    { source: 'grid', target: 'homes', value: 55 },
    { source: 'grid', target: 'businesses', value: 35 },
  ];
</script>
```
